# Support

contribkit is a public **alpha**. Support is best effort. There is no SLA.

- Questions: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/daichunghy/contribkit/discussions)
- Bugs: [issues](https://github.com/daichunghy/contribkit/issues)
- Security: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- Adapters: use the adapter issue form

We will not debug another repository’s GitHub Ruleset, and we will not treat a `pass` receipt as a merge decision.
